        /* Breakpoints */
        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 2rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            }

            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative {
                display: none;
            }
        }

        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            }
        }

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           BASE TYPOGRAPHY & COLORS
           =========================================== */
        body {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        h1 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--title-size);
            line-height: 1.05;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }

        h2 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            line-height: 1.1;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }

        h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        p {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           ANIMATIONS — reveal on scroll-into-view
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(24px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }

        .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.55s; }

        .reveal-left {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(-30px);
            transition: opacity 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-left { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }

        .reveal-right {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(30px);
            transition: opacity 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-right { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }

        /* Stagger for table rows and list items */
        .stagger-row { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-20px); transition: opacity 0.5s var(--ease-out-expo), transform 0.5s var(--ease-out-expo); }
        .slide.visible .stagger-row { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(1)  { transition-delay: 0.1s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(2)  { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(3)  { transition-delay: 0.2s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(4)  { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(5)  { transition-delay: 0.3s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(6)  { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(7)  { transition-delay: 0.4s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(8)  { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(9)  { transition-delay: 0.5s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(10) { transition-delay: 0.55s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(11) { transition-delay: 0.6s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(12) { transition-delay: 0.65s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(13) { transition-delay: 0.7s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(14) { transition-delay: 0.75s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(15) { transition-delay: 0.8s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(16) { transition-delay: 0.85s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(17) { transition-delay: 0.9s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(18) { transition-delay: 0.95s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(19) { transition-delay: 1.0s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(20) { transition-delay: 1.05s; }

        /* ===========================================
           PROGRESS BAR
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: var(--accent-red);
            z-index: 1000;
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
            width: 0%;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           NAVIGATION DOTS
           =========================================== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;

            list-style: none;
        }

        .nav-dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;

            background: var(--text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            border: none;
            padding: 0;
        }

        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent-red);
            transform: scale(1.5);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SHARED STRUCTURAL ELEMENTS
           =========================================== */
        .slide-num {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .tag {
            display: inline-block;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);

        .tag-red   { background: var(--accent-red);   color: #fff; }

        .tag-green { background: var(--accent-green); color: #000; }
        .tag-yellow{ background: var(--accent-yellow);color: #000; }
        .tag-muted { background: var(--bg-card-alt);  color: var(--text-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-mid); }

        /* Grid line decoration */
        .grid-bg {
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 48px 48px;
        }

        /* Red accent bar — left edge */
        .accent-bar::before {
            content: '';

            left: 0;
            top: 0;
            bottom: 0;

            background: var(--accent-red);
        }

        /* Horizontal rule */
        .rule {
            border: none;

        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1 — TITLE SLIDE
           =========================================== */
        #slide-title {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
        }

        #slide-title .title-inner {

            grid-template-rows: 1fr auto;

            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            gap: var(--element-gap);
        }

        #slide-title .top-bar {
            grid-column: 1 / -1;

        #slide-title .main-content {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;

            padding: clamp(1rem, 3vh, 3rem) 0;

        #slide-title .eyebrow {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);

            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }

        #slide-title h1 {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            max-width: 16ch;

        #slide-title h1 .red { color: var(--accent-red); }

        #slide-title .subtitle {
            margin-top: clamp(0.75rem, 2vh, 1.5rem);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);

        }

        #slide-title .bottom-bar {
            grid-column: 1 / -1;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding-top: clamp(0.5rem, 2vh, 1.5rem);
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
        }

        #slide-title .stat-callout {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 4rem);
        }

        #slide-title .stat-item .val {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 3vw, 2rem);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        #slide-title .stat-item .lbl {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;

        }

        /* Large number watermark */
        #slide-title .watermark {
            position: absolute;
            right: clamp(1rem, 4vw, 5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            font-family: var(--font-display);

            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.025);
            line-height: 1;
            pointer-events: none;
            user-select: none;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2 — TOP 20 TABLE
           =========================================== */
        #slide-top20 {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
        }

        #slide-top20 .layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.5rem);
        }

        #slide-top20 .slide-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-end;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 1rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        #slide-top20 .table-wrap {
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        .rankings-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            flex: 1;
        }

        .rankings-table thead th {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem) clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-mid);
            text-align: left;
        }

        .rankings-table thead th.num { text-align: center; }
        .rankings-table thead th.pct { text-align: right; }
        .rankings-table thead th.chg { text-align: right; }

        .rankings-table tbody tr {
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            transition: background 0.2s ease;
        }

        .rankings-table tbody tr:hover { background: var(--bg-card); }

        .rankings-table tbody tr.highlight-row { background: rgba(255, 51, 0, 0.07); }

        }

        .rankings-table .rank-col { text-align: center; }

        .rank-num {

        .lang-name {

        .pct-cell {

        }

        .pct-bar-cell { width: clamp(4rem, 10vw, 12rem); }

        .pct-bar-wrap {

        .pct-bar-bg {
            flex: 1;

        .pct-bar-fill {

            { rank:17, prev:17, lang:'Assembly',             rating:1.29,  chg:'+0.42%', chgClass:'chg-pos' },
            { rank:18, prev:13, lang:'PHP',                  rating:1.23,  chg:'-0.25%', chgClass:'chg-neg' },

        ];

        /* ===========================================
           BUILD RANKINGS TABLE
           =========================================== */
        function buildTable() {
            const tbody = document.getElementById('rankingsBody');
            const maxRating = rankings[0].rating; // Python 21.25

            rankings.forEach((r, i) => {
                const rankDelta = r.prev - r.rank;
                let arrow, arrowClass;
                if (rankDelta > 0)      { arrow = '▲'; arrowClass = 'arrow-up'; }
                else if (rankDelta < 0) { arrow = '▼'; arrowClass = 'arrow-down'; }
                else                   { arrow = '—'; arrowClass = 'arrow-flat'; }

                const isHighlight = r.rank <= 4;
                const rankClass   = r.rank <= 4 ? 'rank-top' : 'rank-reg';
                const barWidth    = ((r.rating / maxRating) * 100).toFixed(1);

                const tr = document.createElement('tr');
                tr.className = 'stagger-row' + (isHighlight ? ' highlight-row' : '');
                tr.innerHTML = `
                    <td class="rank-col"><span class="rank-num ${rankClass}">${r.rank}</span></td>
                    <td><span class="lang-name">${r.lang}</span></td>
                    <td style="text-align:center"><span class="rank-arrow ${arrowClass}">${arrow}</span></td>
                    <td class="prev-rank">${r.prev}</td>
                    <td class="pct-cell">${r.rating.toFixed(2)}%</td>
                    <td class="pct-bar-cell">

                            <div class="pct-bar-bg">
                                <div class="pct-bar-fill" data-width="${barWidth}" style="width:0%"></div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </td>
                    <td class="chg-cell ${r.chgClass}">${r.chg}</td>
                `;
                tbody.appendChild(tr);
            });
        }

        /* Animate bar fills when slide becomes visible */
        function animateBars(slide) {
            slide.querySelectorAll('.pct-bar-fill').forEach(bar => {
                const w = bar.getAttribute('data-width');
                requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    setTimeout(() => { bar.style.width = w + '%'; }, 100);
                });
            });
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
           =========================================== */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
                this.totalSlides = this.slides.length;
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;

                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.navDotsContainer = document.getElementById('navDots');

                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupWheelNav();
                this.setupScrollSync();

                // Trigger first slide immediately
                this.slides[0].classList.add('visible');
                this.updateProgress(0);
                this.updateNavDots(0);
                animateBars(this.slides[0]);
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const btn = document.createElement('button');
                    btn.className = 'nav-dot';
                    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    this.navDotsContainer.appendChild(btn);
                });
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting && entry.intersectionRatio > 0.5) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentSlide = idx;
                                this.updateProgress(idx);
                                this.updateNavDots(idx);
                                animateBars(entry.target);
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    switch (e.key) {
                        case 'ArrowDown':
                        case 'ArrowRight':
                        case ' ':
                        case 'PageDown':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.totalSlides - 1));
                            break;
                        case 'ArrowUp':
                        case 'ArrowLeft':
                        case 'PageUp':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                            break;
                        case 'Home':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(0);
                            break;
                        case 'End':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.totalSlides - 1);
                            break;
                    }
                });
            }

            setupWheelNav() {
                let wheelCooldown = false;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    if (wheelCooldown) return;
                    wheelCooldown = true;
                    if (e.deltaY > 30) {
                        this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.totalSlides - 1));
                    } else if (e.deltaY < -30) {
                        this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                    }
                    setTimeout(() => { wheelCooldown = false; }, 700);
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const delta = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(delta) > 50) {
                        if (delta > 0) this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.totalSlides - 1));
                        else           this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupScrollSync() {
                /* Keep currentSlide in sync with native scroll */
                window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
                    const scrollTop = window.scrollY;
                    const vh = window.innerHeight;
                    const idx = Math.round(scrollTop / vh);
                    if (idx !== this.currentSlide) {
                        this.currentSlide = Math.max(0, Math.min(idx, this.totalSlides - 1));
                        this.updateProgress(this.currentSlide);
                        this.updateNavDots(this.currentSlide);
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            goToSlide(idx) {
                this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                this.currentSlide = idx;
                this.updateProgress(idx);
                this.updateNavDots(idx);
            }

            updateProgress(idx) {
                const pct = this.totalSlides > 1 ? (idx / (this.totalSlides - 1)) * 100 : 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            updateNavDots(idx) {
                const dots = this.navDotsContainer.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
                dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx));
            }
        }

        buildTable();
        new SlidePresentation();
    </script>
</body>

            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
        }

        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }

        .card, .container, .content-box {
            max-width: min(90vw, 1000px);
            max-height: min(80vh, 700px);
        }

        .feature-list, .bullet-list {
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 1rem);
        }

        .feature-list li, .bullet-list li {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        img, .image-container {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: min(50vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        /* Breakpoints */
        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 2rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            }

            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative {
                display: none;
            }
        }

        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            }
        }

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           BASE TYPOGRAPHY & COLORS
           =========================================== */
        body {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        h1 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--title-size);
            line-height: 1.05;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }

        h2 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            line-height: 1.1;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }

        h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        p {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           ANIMATIONS — reveal on scroll-into-view
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(24px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }

        .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.55s; }

        .reveal-left {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(-30px);
            transition: opacity 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-left { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }

        .reveal-right {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(30px);
            transition: opacity 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-right { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }

        /* Stagger for table rows and list items */
        .stagger-row { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-20px); transition: opacity 0.5s var(--ease-out-expo), transform 0.5s var(--ease-out-expo); }
        .slide.visible .stagger-row { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(1)  { transition-delay: 0.1s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(2)  { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(3)  { transition-delay: 0.2s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(4)  { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(5)  { transition-delay: 0.3s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(6)  { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(7)  { transition-delay: 0.4s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(8)  { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(9)  { transition-delay: 0.5s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(10) { transition-delay: 0.55s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(11) { transition-delay: 0.6s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(12) { transition-delay: 0.65s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(13) { transition-delay: 0.7s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(14) { transition-delay: 0.75s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(15) { transition-delay: 0.8s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(16) { transition-delay: 0.85s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(17) { transition-delay: 0.9s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(18) { transition-delay: 0.95s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(19) { transition-delay: 1.0s; }
        .stagger-row:nth-child(20) { transition-delay: 1.05s; }

        /* ===========================================
           PROGRESS BAR
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: var(--accent-red);
            z-index: 1000;
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
            width: 0%;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           NAVIGATION DOTS
           =========================================== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(6px, 1vh, 10px);
            z-index: 100;
            list-style: none;
        }

        .nav-dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            border: none;
            padding: 0;
        }

        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent-red);
            transform: scale(1.5);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SHARED STRUCTURAL ELEMENTS
           =========================================== */
        .slide-num {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .tag {
            display: inline-block;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            padding: 0.2em 0.6em;
            border-radius: 2px;
        }

        .tag-red   { background: var(--accent-red);   color: #fff; }
        .tag-blue  { background: var(--accent-blue);  color: #fff; }
        .tag-green { background: var(--accent-green); color: #000; }
        .tag-yellow{ background: var(--accent-yellow);color: #000; }
        .tag-muted { background: var(--bg-card-alt);  color: var(--text-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-mid); }

        /* Grid line decoration */
        .grid-bg {
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 48px 48px;
        }

        /* Red accent bar — left edge */
        .accent-bar::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            width: 4px;
            background: var(--accent-red);
        }

        /* Horizontal rule */
        .rule {
            border: none;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border-mid);
            margin: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.5rem) 0;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1 — TITLE SLIDE
           =========================================== */
        #slide-title {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
        }

        #slide-title .title-inner {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
            grid-template-rows: 1fr auto;
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            gap: var(--element-gap);
        }

        #slide-title .top-bar {
            grid-column: 1 / -1;
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding-bottom: clamp(1rem, 3vh, 3rem);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
        }

        #slide-title .main-content {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: clamp(1rem, 3vh, 3rem) 0;
        }

        #slide-title .eyebrow {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--accent-red);
            letter-spacing: 0.15em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }

        #slide-title h1 {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            max-width: 16ch;
        }

        #slide-title h1 .red { color: var(--accent-red); }

        #slide-title .subtitle {
            margin-top: clamp(0.75rem, 2vh, 1.5rem);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            max-width: 55ch;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        #slide-title .bottom-bar {
            grid-column: 1 / -1;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding-top: clamp(0.5rem, 2vh, 1.5rem);
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
        }

        #slide-title .stat-callout {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 4rem);
        }

        #slide-title .stat-item .val {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 3vw, 2rem);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        #slide-title .stat-item .lbl {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        }

        /* Large number watermark */
        #slide-title .watermark {
            position: absolute;
            right: clamp(1rem, 4vw, 5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(8rem, 20vw, 18rem);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.025);
            line-height: 1;
            pointer-events: none;
            user-select: none;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2 — TOP 20 TABLE
           =========================================== */
        #slide-top20 {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
        }

        #slide-top20 .layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.5rem);
        }

        #slide-top20 .slide-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-end;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 1rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        #slide-top20 .table-wrap {
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        .rankings-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            flex: 1;
        }

        .rankings-table thead th {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem) clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-mid);
            text-align: left;
        }

        .rankings-table thead th.num { text-align: center; }
        .rankings-table thead th.pct { text-align: right; }
        .rankings-table thead th.chg { text-align: right; }

        .rankings-table tbody tr {
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            transition: background 0.2s ease;
        }

        .rankings-table tbody tr:hover { background: var(--bg-card); }

        .rankings-table tbody tr.highlight-row { background: rgba(255, 51, 0, 0.07); }
        .rankings-table tbody tr.highlight-row:hover { background: rgba(255, 51, 0, 0.12); }

        .rankings-table tbody td {
            padding: clamp(0.25rem, 0.6vh, 0.5rem) clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            vertical-align: middle;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .rankings-table .rank-col { text-align: center; }

        .rank-num {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            width: clamp(1.2rem, 2vw, 1.6rem);
            height: clamp(1.2rem, 2vw, 1.6rem);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            border-radius: 3px;
        }

        .rank-top { background: var(--accent-red); color: #fff; }
        .rank-reg { background: var(--bg-card-alt); color: var(--text-secondary); }

        .lang-name {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
        }

        .prev-rank {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .pct-cell {
            text-align: right;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .pct-bar-cell { width: clamp(4rem, 10vw, 12rem); }

        .pct-bar-wrap {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.4rem;
        }

        .pct-bar-bg {
            flex: 1;
            height: 4px;
            background: var(--bg-card-alt);
            border-radius: 2px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .pct-bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 2px;
            background: var(--accent-red);
            transition: width 1s var(--ease-out-expo) 0.3s;
            width: 0%;
        }

        .slide.visible .pct-bar-fill {
            /* width is set by inline style; transition kicks in */
        }

        .chg-cell {
            text-align: right;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .chg-pos { color: var(--accent-green); }
        .chg-neg { color: var(--accent-red); }
        .chg-neu { color: var(--text-muted); }

        .rank-arrow {
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            display: inline-block;
        }

        .arrow-up   { color: var(--accent-green); }
        .arrow-down { color: var(--accent-red); }
        .arrow-flat { color: var(--text-muted); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3 — BIGGEST MOVERS
           =========================================== */
        #slide-movers {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
        }

        #slide-movers .layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.5rem);
        }

        .movers-split {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 3rem);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .movers-panel {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 1rem);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .panel-label {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        .mover-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem) clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1.25rem);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .mover-card.gainer { border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-green); }
        .mover-card.loser  { border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-red); }

        .mover-delta {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.75rem);
            line-height: 1;
            min-width: 3ch;
            text-align: right;
        }

        .mover-delta.pos { color: var(--accent-green); }
        .mover-delta.neg { color: var(--accent-red); }

        .mover-info {
            flex: 1;
        }

        .mover-name {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .mover-ranks {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: 0.2em;
        }

        .mover-pct {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-weight: 700;
        }
        .mover-pct.pos { color: var(--accent-green); }
        .mover-pct.neg { color: var(--accent-red); }

        .divider-line {
            position: absolute;
            left: 50%;
            top: var(--slide-padding);
            bottom: var(--slide-padding);
            width: 1px;
            background: var(--border-mid);
            transform: translateX(-50%);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4 — HISTORICAL
           =========================================== */
        #slide-historical {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
        }

        #slide-historical .layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.5rem);
        }

        .historical-body {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 3rem);
            overflow: hidden;
            min-height: 0;
        }

        .hist-table-wrap {
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            min-height: 0;
        }

        .hist-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-size: var(--label-size);
        }

        .hist-table th {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: calc(var(--label-size) * 0.9);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            padding: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem) clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-mid);
            text-align: center;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .hist-table th.lang-col { text-align: left; }

        .hist-table td {
            padding: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem) clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
            text-align: center;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: calc(var(--label-size) * 0.9);
        }

        .hist-table td.lang-name-col {
            text-align: left;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .hist-table td.rank-1 { color: var(--accent-red); font-weight: 700; }
        .hist-table td.rank-2 { color: #ff8866; font-weight: 700; }
        .hist-table td.rank-3 { color: var(--accent-yellow); font-weight: 600; }
        .hist-table td.rank-na { color: var(--text-muted); }

        .hist-trend-panel {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
            overflow: hidden;
            min-height: 0;
        }

        .trend-item {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem) clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1.25rem);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .trend-item::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            width: 3px;
        }

        .trend-item.t-python::before { background: var(--accent-yellow); }
        .trend-item.t-c::before      { background: var(--accent-blue); }
        .trend-item.t-java::before   { background: #ff8800; }
        .trend-item.t-js::before     { background: #f0db4f; }

        .trend-lang {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: 0.2em;
        }

        .trend-desc {
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.45;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5 — HALL OF FAME
           =========================================== */
        #slide-hof {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
        }

        #slide-hof .layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.5rem);
        }

        .hof-body {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 3rem);
            overflow: hidden;
            align-items: start;
        }

        .hof-winners-col {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.7rem);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .hof-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);

    <script>
        /* ===========================================
           RANKINGS DATA — Top 20 March 2026
           Source: source_brief.md

        const rankings = [
            { rank:1,  prev:1,  lang:'Python',               rating:21.25, chg:'-2.59%', chgClass:'chg-neg' },

            { rank:17, prev:17, lang:'Assembly',             rating:1.29,  chg:'+0.42%', chgClass:'chg-pos' },
            { rank:18, prev:13, lang:'PHP',                  rating:1.23,  chg:'-0.25%', chgClass:'chg-neg' },
            { rank:19, prev:18, lang:'Ada',                  rating:1.10,  chg:'+0.25%', chgClass:'chg-pos' },
            { rank:20, prev:26, lang:'Swift',                rating:1.04,  chg:'+0.44%', chgClass:'chg-pos' },
        ];

        /* ===========================================
           BUILD RANKINGS TABLE
           =========================================== */
        function buildTable() {
            const tbody = document.getElementById('rankingsBody');
            const maxRating = rankings[0].rating; // Python 21.25

            rankings.forEach((r, i) => {
                const rankDelta = r.prev - r.rank;
                let arrow, arrowClass;
                if (rankDelta > 0)      { arrow = '▲'; arrowClass = 'arrow-up'; }
                else if (rankDelta < 0) { arrow = '▼'; arrowClass = 'arrow-down'; }
                else                   { arrow = '—'; arrowClass = 'arrow-flat'; }

                const isHighlight = r.rank <= 4;
                const rankClass   = r.rank <= 4 ? 'rank-top' : 'rank-reg';
                const barWidth    = ((r.rating / maxRating) * 100).toFixed(1);

                const tr = document.createElement('tr');
                tr.className = 'stagger-row' + (isHighlight ? ' highlight-row' : '');
                tr.innerHTML = `
                    <td class="rank-col"><span class="rank-num ${rankClass}">${r.rank}</span></td>
                    <td><span class="lang-name">${r.lang}</span></td>
                    <td style="text-align:center"><span class="rank-arrow ${arrowClass}">${arrow}</span></td>
                    <td class="prev-rank">${r.prev}</td>
                    <td class="pct-cell">${r.rating.toFixed(2)}%</td>
                    <td class="pct-bar-cell">
                        <div class="pct-bar-wrap">
                            <div class="pct-bar-bg">
                                <div class="pct-bar-fill" data-width="${barWidth}" style="width:0%"></div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </td>
                    <td class="chg-cell ${r.chgClass}">${r.chg}</td>
                `;
                tbody.appendChild(tr);
            });
        }

        /* Animate bar fills when slide becomes visible */
        function animateBars(slide) {
            slide.querySelectorAll('.pct-bar-fill').forEach(bar => {
                const w = bar.getAttribute('data-width');
                requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    setTimeout(() => { bar.style.width = w + '%'; }, 100);
                });
            });
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
           =========================================== */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
                this.totalSlides = this.slides.length;
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;

                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.navDotsContainer = document.getElementById('navDots');

                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupWheelNav();
                this.setupScrollSync();

                // Trigger first slide immediately
                this.slides[0].classList.add('visible');
                this.updateProgress(0);
                this.updateNavDots(0);
                animateBars(this.slides[0]);
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const btn = document.createElement('button');
                    btn.className = 'nav-dot';
                    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    this.navDotsContainer.appendChild(btn);
                });
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting && entry.intersectionRatio > 0.5) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentSlide = idx;
                                this.updateProgress(idx);
                                this.updateNavDots(idx);
                                animateBars(entry.target);
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    switch (e.key) {
                        case 'ArrowDown':
                        case 'ArrowRight':
                        case ' ':
                        case 'PageDown':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.totalSlides - 1));
                            break;
                        case 'ArrowUp':
                        case 'ArrowLeft':
                        case 'PageUp':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                            break;
                        case 'Home':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(0);
                            break;
                        case 'End':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.totalSlides - 1);
                            break;
                    }
                });
            }

            setupWheelNav() {
                let wheelCooldown = false;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    if (wheelCooldown) return;
                    wheelCooldown = true;
                    if (e.deltaY > 30) {
                        this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.totalSlides - 1));
                    } else if (e.deltaY < -30) {
                        this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                    }
                    setTimeout(() => { wheelCooldown = false; }, 700);
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const delta = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(delta) > 50) {
                        if (delta > 0) this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.totalSlides - 1));
                        else           this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupScrollSync() {
                /* Keep currentSlide in sync with native scroll */
                window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
                    const scrollTop = window.scrollY;
                    const vh = window.innerHeight;
                    const idx = Math.round(scrollTop / vh);
                    if (idx !== this.currentSlide) {
                        this.currentSlide = Math.max(0, Math.min(idx, this.totalSlides - 1));
                        this.updateProgress(this.currentSlide);
                        this.updateNavDots(this.currentSlide);
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            goToSlide(idx) {
                this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                this.currentSlide = idx;
                this.updateProgress(idx);
                this.updateNavDots(idx);
            }

            updateProgress(idx) {
                const pct = this.totalSlides > 1 ? (idx / (this.totalSlides - 1)) * 100 : 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            updateNavDots(idx) {
                const dots = this.navDotsContainer.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
                dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx));
            }
        }

        buildTable();
        new SlidePresentation();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

    <style>
        /* ===========================================
           CSS CUSTOM PROPERTIES — Swiss Modern variant

        :root {

        /* ===========================================
           BUILD RANKINGS TABLE
           =========================================== */
        function buildTable() {
            const tbody = document.getElementById('rankingsBody');
            const maxRating = rankings[0].rating; // Python 21.25

            rankings.forEach((r, i) => {
                const rankDelta = r.prev - r.rank;
                let arrow, arrowClass;
                if (rankDelta > 0)      { arrow = '▲'; arrowClass = 'arrow-up'; }
                else if (rankDelta < 0) { arrow = '▼'; arrowClass = 'arrow-down'; }
                else                   { arrow = '—'; arrowClass = 'arrow-flat'; }

                const isHighlight = r.rank <= 4;
                const rankClass   = r.rank <= 4 ? 'rank-top' : 'rank-reg';
                const barWidth    = ((r.rating / maxRating) * 100).toFixed(1);

                const tr = document.createElement('tr');
                tr.className = 'stagger-row' + (isHighlight ? ' highlight-row' : '');
                tr.innerHTML = `
                    <td class="rank-col"><span class="rank-num ${rankClass}">${r.rank}</span></td>
                    <td><span class="lang-name">${r.lang}</span></td>
                    <td style="text-align:center"><span class="rank-arrow ${arrowClass}">${arrow}</span></td>
                    <td class="prev-rank">${r.prev}</td>
                    <td class="pct-cell">${r.rating.toFixed(2)}%</td>
                    <td class="pct-bar-cell">
                        <div class="pct-bar-wrap">
                            <div class="pct-bar-bg">
                                <div class="pct-bar-fill" data-width="${barWidth}" style="width:0%"></div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </td>
                    <td class="chg-cell ${r.chgClass}">${r.chg}</td>
                `;
                tbody.appendChild(tr);
            });
        }

        /* Animate bar fills when slide becomes visible */
        function animateBars(slide) {
            slide.querySelectorAll('.pct-bar-fill').forEach(bar => {
                const w = bar.getAttribute('data-width');
                requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    setTimeout(() => { bar.style.width = w + '%'; }, 100);
                });
            });
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
           =========================================== */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
                this.totalSlides = this.slides.length;
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;

                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.navDotsContainer = document.getElementById('navDots');

                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupWheelNav();
                this.setupScrollSync();

                // Trigger first slide immediately
                this.slides[0].classList.add('visible');
                this.updateProgress(0);
                this.updateNavDots(0);
                animateBars(this.slides[0]);
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const btn = document.createElement('button');
                    btn.className = 'nav-dot';
                    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    this.navDotsContainer.appendChild(btn);
                });
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting && entry.intersectionRatio > 0.5) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentSlide = idx;
                                this.updateProgress(idx);
                                this.updateNavDots(idx);
                                animateBars(entry.target);
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    switch (e.key) {
                        case 'ArrowDown':
                        case 'ArrowRight':
                        case ' ':
                        case 'PageDown':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.totalSlides - 1));
                            break;
                        case 'ArrowUp':
                        case 'ArrowLeft':
                        case 'PageUp':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                            break;
                        case 'Home':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(0);
                            break;
                        case 'End':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.totalSlides - 1);
                            break;
                    }
                });
            }

            setupWheelNav() {
                let wheelCooldown = false;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    if (wheelCooldown) return;
                    wheelCooldown = true;
                    if (e.deltaY > 30) {
                        this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.totalSlides - 1));
                    } else if (e.deltaY < -30) {
                        this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                    }
                    setTimeout(() => { wheelCooldown = false; }, 700);
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const delta = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(delta) > 50) {
                        if (delta > 0) this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.totalSlides - 1));
                        else           this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupScrollSync() {
                /* Keep currentSlide in sync with native scroll */
                window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
                    const scrollTop = window.scrollY;
                    const vh = window.innerHeight;
                    const idx = Math.round(scrollTop / vh);
                    if (idx !== this.currentSlide) {
                        this.currentSlide = Math.max(0, Math.min(idx, this.totalSlides - 1));
                        this.updateProgress(this.currentSlide);
                        this.updateNavDots(this.currentSlide);
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            goToSlide(idx) {
                this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                this.currentSlide = idx;
                this.updateProgress(idx);
                this.updateNavDots(idx);
            }

            updateProgress(idx) {
                const pct = this.totalSlides > 1 ? (idx / (this.totalSlides - 1)) * 100 : 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            updateNavDots(idx) {
                const dots = this.navDotsContainer.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
                dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx));
            }
        }

        buildTable();
        new SlidePresentation();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
